name: Scapple
description: Scapple is freeform mind-mapping software for placing notes anywhere on a virtual sheet, connecting ideas, grouping and styling notes, and moving planning material into other writing workflows.
agentUseSummary: Scapple cannot yet be connected to Relay agents because its published surfaces are local board documents, drag-and-drop interchange, exports, printing, and Scrivener handoff rather than an authorized third-party API.

blocked.label: Connect Scapple
blocked.description: Relay does not accept Scapple serial numbers, purchase email addresses, licences, device, file, Scrivener, or storage credentials without an authorized third-party API contract.

blocked.label: Access Scapple files
blocked.description: Scapple board documents, linked computer files, imported text and images, and exported PDF, PNG, OPML, RTF, RTFD, and text files are local artifacts rather than provider account authority.

blocked.label: Automate Scapple
blocked.description: Relay does not automate the Mac or Windows app, drag-and-drop workflows, Scrivener handoff, private update or licensing services, browser UI, or undocumented document internals.

blocked.label: Change or export boards
blocked.description: Creating, reading, editing, linking, importing, exporting, printing, sharing, or deleting boards and notes remains unavailable until Literature & Latte authorizes a stable distributable integration contract.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled until Literature & Latte authorizes and documents a stable Scapple API or Relay ships a separately permitted local-file connector.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay does not mount unauthorized Scapple automation or silently give OpenClaw access to private boards, linked files, Scrivener material, or exports.
Relay does not mount unauthorized Scapple automation or silently give Hermes access to private boards, linked files, Scrivener material, or exports.

providerSetup.blocker: Scapple publishes a local Mac and Windows application with file-based boards, drag-and-drop import and Scrivener handoff, and user-driven export and printing but no authorized third-party developer API. Literature & Latte states that Scapple's internet access is limited to updates, purchasing, and licence activation, and its EULA prohibits disassembly, decompilation, reverse engineering, adaptation, and modification.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request serial numbers, purchase email addresses, licences, device, file, Scrivener, or storage credentials; inspect undocumented board internals; automate Scapple software or private services; or show Connect. Reconsider only after Literature & Latte supplies written integration authorization and a current distributable API contract, or after Relay ships a separately authorized local-file workflow that complies with Scapple's terms.

evidence.supports: Literature & Latte presents Scapple as local Mac and Windows software operated through direct note editing, drag and drop, export, printing, and dragging notes into Scrivener.
The official manual documents local document import, drag-and-drop interchange, links to computer files, and user-driven export formats rather than a remote API.
Literature & Latte says Scapple's internet use is for update checks, in-app purchase information, and licence activation; update checks send no user information to its web server.

Scapple's EULA grants a limited software licence and prohibits disassembly, decompilation, reverse engineering, adaptation, modification, redistribution, sublicensing, and derivative works except where law requires otherwise.
